notes.title: Production UPDATE
notes.content:
It's been a long time since I last posted! Sorry about that.

HL was suppose to be released this year but due to people deciding it's a good idea to just drop everything and leave, it's not possible. 

I tried to keep production going but at the moment it's completely stopped until I get a loyal production team behind me. 

I don't wanna throw a date out there randomly just to please everybody. I work on HL in my free time because I believe in my vision and I want to see it through.

I want to say thank you to everyone who has been patient and loyal. I ran into this with out a plan B.

Will speak soon!

-Thomas

P.S: I will be in the chat room if anyone wants to ask any questions!

notes.title: Kickstarter and Early Access!
notes.content:
[h1][strike] Early Access [/strike] [/h1] 
The reason early access isn't going to happen is because I don't want people to pay for an unfinished game and it opens the game up for a lot of bad reviews and of course that will have a negative impact on the game's reputation and players will think twice on playing the game.  

[h1] Alpha / Beta [/h1]
Yes! This is happening and I am looking forward to it as much as you all are. Alpha is going to be FREE! Everyone is welcome to try it out. Beta will also be free (just confiming this for people who don't understand how it works). Sadly not everyone is invited to Beta. You will be able to sign up soon on my forums for Alpha access. Dates will be confimed later in the month.

[h1][b] Kickstarter [/b][/h1]

As most of you know I am creating this game on my own and it requires a lot of time and support. I will have to purchase a license for the engine I am using. Please click [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/1274133769/hollows-land-rpg] 	 HERE[/url] and have a look.

any questions post below! :)
